column1: # One creature per hunter pet family, for DPSSIM_PET_FAMILY (run-sim.sh) and pet_family_sweep.py. Blizzard's
# "Tamable <family>" test creatures: one per family, nothing else uses them, no SQL update touches them. Their
# creature level does not matter (the sim's pet takes the actor's level, SimBot.cpp TameSimPet), and
# Player::CreatePet() takes untamable / exotic families too. Tree: the pet talent tree (CreatureFamily.dbc
# PetTalentType). Columns are tab-separated; lines starting with '#' are comments.
